common.attachEmail: Attach my email ({email}) so we can reply

@common.attachEmail.description: Label for an opt-in checkbox to include the user's email so the team can reply. Shared verbatim by the crash-report, error-report, and feedback dialogs. Shown only when the user has an email on file; their actual address is shown in the parentheses.

placeholders.email: the user's email address on file (e.g. alex@example.com)

@common.attachEmail.screenshotNote: Pictured in the error-report dialog; the crash-report and feedback dialogs place the same checkbox above their Send button.

common.downloadsFdaHint: Cmdr needs Full Disk Access to watch your Downloads folder. <settingsLink>Open System Settings</settingsLink>

@common.downloadsFdaHint.description: Hint shown when the downloads watcher lacks Full Disk Access. <settingsLink> wraps the inline action that opens System Settings.
